title: Purity test 500 summary
summary: This is a Usenet-era questionnaire, the 500-question version 4.0 of the "Purity Test", posted to alt.sex in October 1991 by a Purdue University user known as The Dark One. It is a humorous, self-scoring checklist in which the reader answers yes or no to questions about sexual experiences, drug use, petty crime, bodily functions and fetishes, ranging from mild (holding hands, a first date) to outlandish. Its sections cover platonic relations, auto-erotica, ethical misdeeds, drugs, non-platonic and non-primary relations, and alternate practices. The front matter explains the history of the test, which grew from a 1983 CMU version through several revisions at MIT, CMU, Yale and Dartmouth, and gives instructions for running it as a party game. The score is the number of no answers divided by five, and the document ends with mock disclaimers, warranty language and sign-offs. It is a piece of early internet folklore rather than a narrative.
